meta.title: Verify a credential
meta.description: Look up an ADA-certified doula in the ADA registry and see each credential's status today. Free, no account needed.

title: Verify a credential
lede: Look up an ADA-certified doula. The registry shows each credential's status today. A paper certificate shows status only on the day it was issued.

search.heading: Search the registry
search.numberEmpty: Enter a certificate number or Doula ID.
search.howTo: How to read an ADA number
search.prefixes: PD = Postpartum Doula · BD = Birth Doula · TR = Trainer
search.doulaIdFormat: Doula ID, given to each doula by ADA. It starts with #.
search.exactOpens: An exact number opens the record directly.
search.familyEmpty: Enter a family name. Name searches need both names.
search.givenEmpty: Enter a given name. Name searches need both names.
search.nameTooShort: Enter at least {min} characters of the name.
search.nameHint: Type the name in English, or as written in Chinese, Japanese or Korean, for example <zh>陈美琳</zh> or <ko>박지우</ko>.
search.terms: Free. No account needed. For verification only. Not for building contact or marketing lists.
search.searchError: The registry could not be reached. Try again in a moment.

results.heading: {count, plural, one {# record matches} other {# records match}} “{query}”
results.scope: Shown: ADA-certified doulas, including expired, suspended and revoked records. Candidates who have not yet passed the exam are not listed.
results.caption: Matching ADA records
results.noCredential: No credential on record. See the certificate history.
results.showingAll: {count, plural, one {Showing 1 record.} other {Showing all # records.}}
results.showingFirst: Showing the first {count}. Add more of the name to narrow the search.
results.notRight: Not the right person? <link>Search by the certificate number</link> printed on the certificate.

notFound.heading: No ADA record matches “{query}”.
notFound.body: This can mean the name or number is spelled differently, or that the person is not ADA-certified.
notFound.tipNative: Try the name as written in Chinese, Japanese or Korean.
notFound.tipNumber: Use the certificate number printed on the certificate. It looks like <id>{pattern}</id>.
notFound.tipHash: Check the hyphens, and the # at the start of a Doula ID.
notFound.contact: Still can't find the person? Email the registry at <link>{email}</link>.

rail.heading: About verification

legend.active: Meets ADA certification requirements through the date shown.
legend.expired: Was certified, but not renewed by the end date. Not currently ADA-certified. This is not a disciplinary action.
legend.suspended: Not ADA-certified for a set period under the Code of Conduct.
legend.revoked: Certification withdrawn under the Code of Conduct.
legend.retired: Retired in good standing. Not practicing as ADA-certified.
legend.superseded: An older certificate replaced by a newer one, usually at renewal. Check the holder's current standing.
legend.withdrawn: A certificate that is no longer valid. Check the holder's current standing.

rail.realTitle: How to tell a real record
rail.real1: Real ADA records are only on {host}/verify. Check the address bar.
rail.real2: Every record shows the date and time it was retrieved. A screenshot or PDF without that line is not proof.
rail.real3: Looking up a record is free and needs no account.
rail.reportBody: If you have a concern about an ADA-certified doula, tell us. Reports are reviewed confidentially.
